Completed on commit `4ec8dbb` (`fix/remove-post-attn-activation-placeholder`).

Diagnosis: the largest removable empty-semantic leaf was `unified.post_attn.activation`, a byte-only SwiGLU intermediate read/write placeholder. Q/K norms had larger raw cost but are required model math, so they were preserved.

Fix: [post_attn_local.rs](simulator/src/worklet/post_attn_local.rs:1) no longer builds, compiles, or evaluates the standalone activation leaf. Gate/up and down projections remain. Dense callers and location maps were updated accordingly.

Evidence: post-attention leaves changed from `[o_proj, post_norm, up_gate_proj, activation, down_proj]` to `[o_proj, post_norm, up_gate_proj, down_proj]` (`pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`, `pred.casev1.operationv0.cost-tree`). Scoped R0/R5 changed from `0.001559656 / 0.00045688095710677773` to `0.001421476 / 0.00039030457310677776` GPU-s. R6/R7 stayed exactly `0.00029627043293866664 / 0.00029626326493866666` GPU-s. See [before scope](logs/eval_before_baseline/reports/optimality_scoped_path_iter_1_0_3_5b00d806d630.json) and [after scope](logs/eval_before_run/reports/optimality_scoped_path_iter_1_0_3_5b00d806d630.json).

Simulated prediction totals changed from `3.952183246612549` to `3.8557167053222656` ms prefill, and `1.7123689651489258` to `1.670661449432373` ms decode (`pred.overview` for baseline resource `p_55d60f5dc5d345ceab069cf52d8993b6` and after resource `p_bff79597ff6544fd834a43f2134d0de0`). The rerun used warm `profiling/profile.db`, `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''`, and no `--profile`. CPU validation passed: 31 worklet tests, `cargo check -p simulator`, and `git diff --check`.

judge.reasoning: The report targeted a post-attention activation placeholder, whereas the ground truth identified redundant contiguous copies before q_norm and k_norm of strided Q/K views. Removing that activation placeholder does not eliminate either RMSNorm input copy and therefore does not have the same effect.
